# Context before observation

This is an informed first-source diagnostic study for Issue #100, authored after
reading its live inference-law contract, current Reference, common declaration
resolution, finite/sized checking and existing regression tests. No external
model was invoked; exact deployed model and sampling settings were not recorded.
These sources are deliberately small cases of existing syntax, not a blind
benchmark or new inference-language proposal. Static arguments remain explicit.
Missing names are desired diagnostic information, not permission to infer them.

All nine complete projects and 24 planned probes are saved and hashed before
any CLI invocation. No original source will be repaired in place. A diagnostic
may mask later checks; outcomes must name the stage actually reached. The
positive probes check one-qubit open functions, without execution or a claim of
source meaning preservation. Fixed mathematical control meanings are identity
and X, but this first diagnostic run does not measure their action.

The observer reuses the existing tuple CLI build with SHA 15900c32…; its path is
`debug/qleisli`, not the nonexistent requested shorthand `debug/qli`. Historical
build records are linked separately from current source identity. No Rust/Lean
build or schema change is made. A transparent logging wrapper records actual
native invocations and execs the unchanged pinned kernel; zero invocations is
reported only from that per-probe log. Ordinary implementation under the current
QS/PR/RS and EXACT interpretations creates no adoption or proof discharge.
